[id="caching-a-model-on-network-volumes_{context}"]
= Cache a model on network volumes

[role="_abstract"]
You can cache a model on network-attached storage by creating a `LocalModelCache` resource with a `storageClassName` instead of a `nodeGroups` reference.
The controller uses the specified `StorageClass` to dynamically provision persistent volumes for the model download.
Network volume caching is namespace-scoped and does not support cross-namespace sharing.

.Prerequisites

* You have cluster administrator privileges for your {openshift-platform} cluster.
* You have enabled model cache on the cluster.
For more information, see xref:enabling-model-cache_{context}[Enable model cache].
* A `StorageClass` that supports dynamic volume provisioning is available on the cluster.
* If the model is stored in a private registry, you have configured download credentials.
For more information, see xref:configuring-model-download-credentials_{context}[Configure model download credentials].
* You know the model URI, for example `hf://meta-llama/Llama-3-70B`, and the estimated size of the model.

.Procedure

. Verify that a suitable `StorageClass` is available on the cluster:
+
[source,terminal]
----
$ oc get storageclasses
----

. Create a `LocalModelCache` resource with a `storageClassName`:
+
[source,yaml]
----
apiVersion: serving.kserve.io/v1alpha1
kind: LocalModelCache
metadata:
  name: <model_cache_name> <1>
spec:
  sourceModelUri: "<model_uri>" <2>
  modelSize: "<model_size>" <3>
  storageClassName: "<storage_class_name>" <4>
----
+
--
Where:

`<model_cache_name>`:: Specifies a unique name for this cached model, such as `llama3-70b-nfs`.
`<model_uri>`:: Specifies the URI of the model in remote storage, such as `hf://meta-llama/Llama-3-70B`.
This URI must match the `storageUri` used in your `InferenceService` or `LLMInferenceService` resources.
`<model_size>`:: Specifies the estimated size of the model, such as `140Gi`.
`<storage_class_name>`:: Specifies the name of the `StorageClass` to use for provisioning the persistent volume, such as `gp3-csi` or `nfs-storage`.
--
+
[NOTE]
====
Do not include the `nodeGroups` field when using network volume caching.
A `LocalModelNodeGroup` is not required for this caching mode.
====

. Apply the resource:
+
[source,terminal]
----
$ oc apply -f <model_cache_file>.yaml
----
+
The controller provisions a persistent volume claim by using the specified `StorageClass` and creates a download job to populate the volume.

. Monitor the download job progress:
+
[source,terminal]
----
$ oc get jobs -n <job_namespace>
----
+
Replace `<job_namespace>` with the namespace configured for download jobs in the `inferenceservice-config` ConfigMap.
+
[IMPORTANT]
====
Network volume caching does not support cross-namespace sharing.
The cached model is available only to `InferenceService` or `LLMInferenceService` resources in the same namespace as the persistent volume claim.
To use the same model in many namespaces, create a separate `LocalModelCache` resource in each namespace.
====

.Verification

. Verify that the persistent volume claim is created and bound:
+
[source,terminal]
----
$ oc get pvc -l localmodel.kserve.io/model=<model_cache_name>
----
+
The output shows the persistent volume claim in a `Bound` state.

. Verify that the `LocalModelCache` status shows the model is downloaded:
+
[source,terminal]
----
$ oc get localmodelcache <model_cache_name> -o jsonpath='{.status}'
----
+
The status shows the download as complete.
